subject.title: [Feature]: Make detached longwork final delivery ownership explicit

question: Should this issue remain the canonical place to define detached longwork final-delivery ownership, and which existing subagent/task delivery substrate should own the durable obligation?
rationale: The requested behavior is a new owner-mode/API contract over session and message-delivery state; source shows partial mechanisms but no current single-owner product model, and the prior broad PR closed unmerged.

options.title: Keep this as canonical and extend existing delivery state
options.body: Use this issue to choose the owner-mode semantics, then recut small PRs that extend current subagent/task delivery state with docs and live proof.

options.title: Move the invariant to a narrower canonical issue
options.body: If maintainers prefer a Slack/longwork/durable-delivery thread, close or supersede this only after naming that full GitHub URL as the canonical owner.

options.title: Reject a public owner-mode API for now
options.body: Document the current requester-owned behavior and require manual bridge/status notes until a concrete reproduced failure justifies new API surface.

recommendation.title: Keep this as canonical and extend existing delivery state
recommendation.body: Use this issue to choose the owner-mode semantics, then recut small PRs that extend current subagent/task delivery state with docs and live proof.

likelyOwner.reason: He is the best available routing owner from the evidence because he merged the current parent-session routing fix and authored adjacent completion handoff state work.
